paragraphs: OpenBlue is the smart building ecosystem Johnson Controls sells, and the page describes software that pulls building data together and automates the workflows that run on it. The page sorts it into four areas: workplace planning and management, energy efficiency and sustainability, equipment performance and operations efficiency, and workplace experience and productivity.

For workplace planning, the page says OpenBlue reports on space use, portfolio performance and workplace usage so operations can be streamlined. On energy, it states real-time energy intelligence and automated optimization for tracking and reducing energy use and emissions. Two named solutions sit under that area, OpenBlue Net Zero and OpenBlue Central Utility Plant Optimization.
On equipment, the page claims 24/7 monitoring with fault detection and diagnostics to improve equipment health and cut maintenance costs across building systems.

quote.text: Unlock the performance of your building, workforce, & operations
